{{Quote|You shouldn't trust individuals aligned with the Hutts|Garett Erlskel, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:AotSS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Attack on the Space Station|Tatoo system}}</ref>}}
'''Garett Erlskel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] loyal to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Erlskel patrolled the [[Hutt Claims]] region of the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] in his [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]].<ref name="AED" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Garett Erlskel appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Garett Erlskel was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="AED" />
